originalTitle: U.S. stock futures rise sharply; Nasdaq up 1.7% in holiday-thinned trade
summary: Investing.com-- U.S. stock index futures surged on Thursday evening, with Nasdaq futures leading gains amid growing bets on a rebound in battered technology and artificial intelligence valuations.
content:
Investing.com-- U.S. stock index futures surged on Thursday evening, with Nasdaq futures leading gains amid growing bets on a rebound in battered technology and artificial intelligence valuations.

Trading volumes were dulled by the Thanksgiving holiday, with Wall Street also set for a shortened session on Friday.

S&P 500 Futures jumped 1.27% to 7,287.25 points by 21:18 ET (02:18 GMT). Nasdaq 100 Futures rose 1.8% to 26,571.0 points, and Dow Jones Futures rose 0.82% to 50,638.0 points.

Focus was chiefly on a rebound in tech valuations, after deep, extended losses in the sector through October and November.

Signs of a rebound began showing during Wednesday's main session on Wall Street, where U.S. stock indexes overcame sharp initial losses to end well above their session lows, with some bargain buying also seen supporting valuations.

The NASDAQ Composite in particular had slumped as much as 4.5% before recovering to close the day down 0.6%. The S&P 500 fell 0.25%, and the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 0.3%.

An upbeat European and Asian session on Thursday– marked by a rally in tech– are also expected to provide a positive lead-in for Wall Street.

Still, Wall Street is nursing deep losses in November, with the benchmark indexes down between 3% and 7.3%. The Nasdaq is the worst performer among its peers, as an extended rout in tech valuations battered the index.

Concerns over AI– amid growing doubts over whether the debt-fueled spending frenzy on the technology will sustain as interest rates rise– sparked a broad pivot out of tech over the last two months.

A governance scandal at NVIDIA Corporation (NASDAQ:NVDA), which resulted in tighter U.S. restrictions on chip exports to China, also rattled tech, as did increasing conviction that the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates in December.

Markets were also spooked by the Donald Trump administration announcing plans for higher trade tariffs against 14 major trading partners, including China, the European Union, Japan, and India.

chineseTitle: 美股期货大幅上涨；假期交易清淡纳斯达克指数上涨 1.7%
chineseSummary: Investing.com——周四晚间，美国股指期货飙升，纳斯达克期货领涨，因为人们越来越多地押注遭受重创的科技和人工智能估值反弹。
chineseContent:
Investing.com——周四晚间，美国股指期货飙升，纳斯达克期货领涨，因为人们越来越多地押注遭受重创的科技和人工智能估值反弹。

感恩节假期导致交易量减少，华尔街周五也将缩短交易时间。

截至美国东部时间 21:18（格林威治标准时间 02:18），标准普尔 500 指数期货上涨 1.27% 至 7,287.25 点。纳斯达克100期货上涨1.8%至26,571.0点，道琼斯期货上涨0.82%至50,638.0点。

焦点主要集中在科技股估值的反弹上，此前该行业在 10 月和 11 月都出现了大幅、持续的下跌。

周三华尔街主要交易时段开始出现反弹迹象，美国股指克服了最初的大幅跌幅，最终远高于盘中低点，一些逢低买盘也支撑了估值。

尤其是纳斯达克综合指数，一度暴跌 4.5%，随后反弹，收盘下跌 0.6%。标准普尔 500 指数下跌 0.25%，道琼斯工业平均指数上涨 0.3%。

周四欧洲和亚洲市场的乐观情绪（以科技股上涨为标志）预计也将为华尔街带来积极的影响。

尽管如此，华尔街在 11 月份仍遭受严重损失，基准指数下跌 3% 至 7.3%。纳斯达克指数是同类指数中表现最差的，科技股估值的持续下跌对该指数造成了沉重打击。

对人工智能的担忧——人们越来越怀疑债务推动的技术支出狂潮是否会随着利率上升而持续——在过去两个月引发了人们对科技的广泛关注。

NVIDIA 公司（纳斯达克股票代码：NVDA）的治理丑闻导致美国对中国芯片出口实施更严格的限制，这也让科技界感到不安，人们越来越相信美联储将在 12 月加息。

唐纳德·特朗普政府宣布对中国、欧盟、日本和印度等 14 个主要贸易伙伴提高贸易关税的计划也令市场感到震惊。
